modes.name: Ultravox owns conversation
reason: Product truth and campaign facts must remain project-owned.
Final sales logic must remain project-owned.
Canonical memory, verifier, and side-effect prevention must remain project-owned.
modes.rejection_boundary: Ultravox must not own product truth, campaign facts, final sales logic, side effects, or source-grounded claims.

modes.name: Ultravox calls our project sales-brain tool
flow: tool call to project sandbox sales brain
project returns approved next move plus response text plus prosody hints

tool_request_schema.buyer_utterance_text: sanitized text from the buyer turn
tool_request_schema.requested_action_context: short context label for the current stage or buyer ask

tool_response_schema.prosody_hints: backend-neutral hints, never raw provider tags
tool_response_schema.verifier_status: passed or blocked status from project verifier

memory_handoff_rules: Ultravox may carry short-term session continuity for spoken turn-taking.
Project runtime owns canonical buyer memory.
Project memory wins over Ultravox session memory on conflict.
Only sanitized summaries may enter public evidence.
Raw private audio and raw private transcripts are never copied into evidence.

verifier_boundary.ultravox_must_speak_only_if: tool response allowed_to_speak is true and verifier_status is not blocked

failure_fallback: If tool call fails, ask a natural clarification or end safely.
If verifier blocks the response, do not speak the blocked text.
If project memory conflicts with Ultravox session memory, use project memory.
If provider tool calling cannot preserve this boundary, keep Ultravox as research/reference only.

modes.name: Ultravox as speech frontend only
reason: Preserves project ownership of truth and sales logic.
May be less speech-native than Mode B because the tool boundary is outside the main turn policy.
